turns.user: Does BART have wheelchair access at every station?
turns.message:
Yes — every BART station has accessible elevators, wider fare gates near the elevators, and level boarding on all trains, with designated wheelchair areas in each car.

A few practical notes:
- At some stations you need two elevators to get from street level to the platform.
- Elevators do go out of service occasionally. You can check live status at bart.gov/stations/elevators, and a Station Agent (or the courtesy phone by the elevator) will help you enter or exit if one is down.
